auth_access_model: A private repository requiring authorized membership; contribution tools use an authorized clone. Research reads an explicitly admitted local compiled distribution only, with no network call or automatic acquisition.
identifier_systems: ontology term IRIs in card alignments

discovery_search.note: Literal search and exact-card read over an explicitly authorized local compiler 0.1.0 distribution, pinned by commit and trusted catalog hash; no remote acquisition or semantic ranking.

metadata_schema.note: The commons' own validator, at the reviewed pinned commit, checks every card against the commons' closed schema and its rules. Script actions fail closed when the checkout's tools, schema or contribution rules differ from the pin.

entity_lookup.note: The commons is a concept bundle, not an entity registry, and the skill exposes no lookup.

identifier_crosswalks.note: Cards carry alignment IRIs, but the skill exposes no crosswalk resolution.

abundance_assessment.note: The commons holds concepts, not assessment data.

telemetry_passage.note: The commons holds concepts, not telemetry data.

hatchery.note: The commons holds concepts, not hatchery data.

harvest_fishery.note: The commons holds concepts, not harvest or fishery data.

genetics_gsi.note: The commons holds concepts, not genetics data.

package_metadata_export.note: The commons is not a data package and the skill exports nothing.

provenance_versioning.note: The skill writes each card's in-card citation-ledger table from ledger JSON and runs the card-only check that holds every cited source to a resolved row with a located passage, all with the commons' own scripts at a pinned commit.

bulk_access_api_ergonomics.note: One JSON adapter over the commons' own scripts, run against the user's clone; the commons has no API.

blockers: The commons is private, so the skill needs a local clone that contains the pinned commit; the plugin cannot fetch it.
The adapter needs uv, or a Python with PyYAML and jsonschema, to run the commons' scripts.
Changed tools, schema or contribution rules block validation, card checks and ledger generation until the plugin has a reviewed compatible pin; runtime and checklist are inspection only.
Research needs a clean Git-derived compiler 0.1.0 distribution and a trusted catalog SHA-256 supplied by its authorized builder.
governance_constraints: The public plugin carries no commons content: the skill reads the commons' scripts and CONTRIBUTING.md from the user's clone at run time and deletes its copies afterwards.
Writing a card or its ledger is not verifying it, and what an agent may merge in the commons is set by the commons' own CONTRIBUTING.md, which the skill prints.
Research retrieval preserves recorded draft, generation, verification, stale and conflict context. Full versus promote distribution mode does not authorize disclosure or scientific acceptance.
watch_fields: the command-line options of okf-check.py, ledger_table.py and ledger_check.py
the ledger JSON keys ledger_table.py reads
compiler distribution version, research JSON artifacts, catalog and manifest integrity contract
